events.title: Kroger Q2 FY2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Grocery bellwether tests consumer resilience amid food inflation and the July retail-sales decline; revenue est. $34.65B.
events.what_to_watch: Identical sales growth, new CEO turnaround plan, and food inflation pass-through.

events.title: OPEC+ JMMC meeting (October quotas) — output unchanged
events.why_it_matters: OPEC+ kept October output unchanged at September levels; Hormuz disruptions, not quotas, are the binding supply constraint.
events.what_to_watch: Whether OPEC+ signals any emergency response if Hormuz stays blocked.

events.title: China August trade data — exports +25% y/y
events.why_it_matters: Exports surged 25% y/y to $401B, imports +28.2%, trade surplus widened to $119B — AI/electronics demand and tariff diversion still offset weak domestic demand.
events.what_to_watch: Whether record surplus escalates US tariff pressure ahead of Trump-Xi summit.

events.title: US August NFP — +162k blowout
events.why_it_matters: Nonfarm payrolls surged to +162k vs ~53-58k expected, unemployment steady at 4.1% — reshaped Fed hike odds higher and roiled markets.
events.what_to_watch: Residual market impact into CPI and FOMC; whether UBS's two-hike 2026 forecast gains traction.

events.title: Google ad-tech antitrust ruling — no breakup
events.why_it_matters: Federal judge ruled Google must change ad-tech practices but rejected DOJ's breakup request — third Big Tech antitrust loss that avoids structural remedy.
events.what_to_watch: Appeals and remedy specifics; read-through to other Big Tech antitrust cases.

events.title: US Section 232 drone/UAS tariffs live
events.why_it_matters: 100% duties on larger/thermal UAS and 25% on smaller drones went live Sept 3, aimed at China supply chains with 10-15% allied caps.
events.what_to_watch: Supply-chain reshuffling and allied exemptions.

events.title: Boeing SPEEA engineer contract negotiations resume
events.why_it_matters: Engineers/technicians rejected Boeing's 'best and final offer' and authorized a strike; talks resume today — a strike could threaten the 737 MAX 42/month rate.
events.what_to_watch: Whether a deal is reached or a strike is called; production impact.

events.title: USMCA 4th round review talks (Washington)
events.why_it_matters: US withheld USMCA renewal July 1, leaving pact on annual clock; 4th round in Washington this week is decisive for auto rules-of-origin and Section 232 tariffs.
events.what_to_watch: Whether US softens 50% US-content demand for autos; Canada's role amid tariff war.

events.title: US midterm elections (Nov 3) — positioning builds
events.why_it_matters: Democrats favored to win at least one chamber; markets starting to price divided-government scenarios and potential debt-ceiling fights.
events.what_to_watch: Polling trends and any policy positioning that moves sector bets.

events.title: US debt ceiling / X-date risk building
events.why_it_matters: Debt ceiling at $41.1T; CBO projects X-date could hit in late 2026, with Treasury accounting devices giving a few months of leeway.
events.what_to_watch: Treasury cash balance and any legislative action on the debt limit post-midterms.

events.title: Hurricane Lowell / Atlantic hurricane season
events.why_it_matters: Major Hurricane Lowell passing west of Hawaii; Tropical Storm Edouard made landfall in Louisiana — active season adds energy/insurance volatility.
events.what_to_watch: Any Gulf of Mexico energy infrastructure threats as season peaks.

events.title: ISM Services PMI (August) — 55.4 beat
events.why_it_matters: Services PMI surged to 55.4 from 54.1, beating forecasts — but employment subindex softness complicates the Fed's read.
events.what_to_watch: Whether services strength persists into Q4.

events.title: Fed's Waller hold-lean comments
events.why_it_matters: Governor Waller said he's inclined to leave rates unchanged if inflation softens — but the NFP blowout 1 day later muddied that signal.
events.what_to_watch: Whether Waller or other doves walk back after the strong jobs print.

events.title: FOMC September decision (first Warsh SEP/dots)
events.why_it_matters: Funds rate 3.50-3.75%; blowout NFP (+162k) and Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole speech have pushed hike odds to ~50-60%, making this the single biggest market catalyst of the window.
events.what_to_watch: Whether Warsh delivers a hike despite Trump pressure; SEP dots and press conference tone.

events.title: US-Iran Strait of Hormuz conflict escalation
events.why_it_matters: CENTCOM struck 3 Iranian oil tankers Sep 7; Houthis attacked Saudi energy facilities Sep 8 wounding 73; Brent ~$98 and Dow dropped 500 points as oil nears $100.
events.what_to_watch: Whether Iran's 'prohibited zone' around Hormuz escalates further; Saudi retaliation against Houthis; oil above $100.

events.title: US August CPI
events.why_it_matters: July CPI was +3.4% y/y; August will capture the Hormuz oil spike feeding the energy channel directly into the FOMC decision.
events.what_to_watch: Whether headline CPI ticks above 3.4% on energy; core inflation trajectory.

events.title: US August PPI
events.why_it_matters: July PPI was +4.7% y/y; pipeline read into CPI and the FOMC decision.
events.what_to_watch: Wholesale energy and input price acceleration from Hormuz disruptions.

events.title: ECB rate decision (Berlin)
events.why_it_matters: Deposit rate 2.25%; euro-area flash CPI hit 3.3% y/y in August on energy (+14.3%), markets price ~80-95% odds of a 25bp hike to 2.50%.
events.what_to_watch: Whether ECB hikes despite growth concerns; Lagarde's forward guidance on energy-driven inflation.

events.title: Bank of Japan policy meeting
events.why_it_matters: Policy rate 1.0%; Reuters poll shows majority of economists expect a hike to 1.25% in September as yen weakness and energy import costs lift upside inflation risks.
events.what_to_watch: Whether yen gains since NFP reduce urgency for a hike; BOJ guidance on pace.

events.title: Bank of England rate decision
events.why_it_matters: Bank Rate 3.75% after June/July holds; inflation climbed to 2.9%, markets moved from pricing cuts to pricing first rise.
events.what_to_watch: Whether MPC splits further toward a hike; energy volatility impact on UK inflation outlook.

events.title: Canada dollar-for-dollar tariffs take effect
events.why_it_matters: Ottawa matches US 50% Section 338 duties on ~$27.6B of US goods (steel, furniture, apparel, dairy, electronics) effective 12:01 a.m. today.
events.what_to_watch: Whether trade talks resume; impact on auto/steel supply chains and consumer prices in both countries.

events.title: Apple 'Surprise and Shine' iPhone 18 / foldable Ultra event
events.why_it_matters: First hardware event under CEO John Ternus; expected iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max and first foldable (iPhone Ultra) starting near $2,000.
events.what_to_watch: Foldable pricing/supply, pre-order demand signals, and impact on Apple supply chain (TSMC, Samsung, LG).

events.title: Oracle Q1 FY2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Cloud-infrastructure print tests AI-capex spend beyond Nvidia/Dell/Broadcom hardware; consensus EPS $1.74 on revenue $19.13B.
events.what_to_watch: Whether RPO backlog converts to revenue; cloud infrastructure growth vs hyperscaler competition.

events.title: Adobe Q3 FY2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Software/AI-tools bellwether tests whether generative-AI monetization is offsetting creative-cloud saturation; EPS est. $6.09.
events.what_to_watch: CEO transition impact; AI-first ARR growth and net-new creative cloud subscribers.

events.title: OPEC+ JMMC meeting — output unchanged
events.why_it_matters: OPEC+ kept October output unchanged at September levels; Hormuz disruptions, not quotas, are the binding supply constraint.
events.what_to_watch: Whether OPEC+ signals emergency production increase if oil breaches $100.

events.title: China August CPI/PPI
events.why_it_matters: July CPI was only +0.5% y/y; a still-soft print keeps the easing-bias case alive even as PBoC holds LPR at record lows.
events.what_to_watch: Whether PPI deflation deepens; signals for further PBoC easing.

events.title: US August retail sales
events.why_it_matters: July retail sales fell -0.6% (first decline in 9 months); drops on FOMC day two and is the consumer-resilience check.
events.what_to_watch: Whether August rebound materializes or confirms consumer slowdown from energy prices.

events.title: Houthi attacks on Saudi energy facilities
events.why_it_matters: Iran-backed Houthis attacked Saudi cities and energy facilities wounding 73, igniting fires at oil facilities — Brent near $98 and Dow dropped 500 points.
events.what_to_watch: Saudi retaliation ('respond firmly'); whether oil breaches $100 and forces emergency OPEC+ action.

events.title: Trump-Xi summit in Washington (Sept 24)
events.why_it_matters: Xi to visit White House Sept 24; trade truce extension 'almost certain' but China's record $119B monthly surplus and new tariff threats loom over talks.
events.what_to_watch: Whether 'nonsensitive' tariff cuts materialize; tech export controls; CEO delegation signals.

events.title: BRICS Summit — New Delhi
events.why_it_matters: India hosts BRICS with expansion debate (Pakistan, Bangladesh aspirants); Modi-Putin bilateral on agenda; China uses bloc to project alternative to US-led order.
events.what_to_watch: Whether BRICS pushes de-dollarization or Iran/Russia alignment that pressures Western sanctions regime.

events.title: Germany state election — AfD landslide in Saxony-Anhalt
events.why_it_matters: AfD won a historic state election victory, signaling rising anti-establishment sentiment and potential policy paralysis in Berlin ahead of federal elections.
events.what_to_watch: Coalition formation attempts; impact on federal government stability and EU fiscal policy stance.

top_risks: Full-blown US-Iran conflict closing Strait of Hormuz, pushing oil above $100 and triggering global supply shock
Fed forced to hike into slowing growth as energy-driven inflation spikes (stagflation risk)
US-China trade war escalation after record Chinese surplus and tariff threats ahead of Trump-Xi summit
Canada-US trade rift deepening with dollar-for-dollar tariffs disrupting integrated supply chains
ECB/BOJ/BOE synchronized hawkish surprises amplifying global tightening
top_opportunities: Energy sector long exposure as geopolitical risk premium expands with oil approaching $100
Defensive sectors (utilities, healthcare) as hedge against stagflation and geopolitical volatility
US dollar strength play on Fed hawkish repricing vs G10 peers
Gold and safe-haven assets amid Middle East escalation and trade war uncertainty
Selective tech longs on Apple foldable launch and AI infrastructure earnings beats
summary: Global markets face a confluence of escalating geopolitical risk (US-Iran conflict, Houthi attacks on Saudi energy, Canada-US trade war) and a hawkish central bank repricing led by the Fed, ECB, and BOJ. Oil near $100 threatens to push inflation higher just as the FOMC weighs its first hike under Chair Warsh. Key data (CPI, PPI, retail sales) and the FOMC decision dominate the next two weeks, while the Trump-Xi summit and BRICS meeting add diplomatic uncertainty. Equity markets are vulnerable to a risk-off shock if oil breaches $100 or the Fed delivers a hawkish surprise.
